identity.opening_binding_lifetime: An already bound opening cannot be rebound to a different immutable identity at the same start; current trade outages cannot erase it.

units.all_integer_times: Unix milliseconds unless field ends in _at and contains an RFC3339 string
units.price: exact base-10 USDT string, rust_decimal 1.42.1 Decimal::normalize() after checked_div by 60000
units.official_reference: independent USD market reference, never replaced by Binance opening estimate
units.current_source_epoch: The live stream's present epoch; never used as an alias for historical opening provenance.

opening_method.name: last_trade_price_time_weighted_over_preceding_60000ms
opening_method.carry: Last real trade price is carried between supplier trade times, including the one real predecessor strictly before the interval.
opening_method.seconds_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 ASCII prefix marketcow.binance-opening-seconds.v1 followed by LF, then 60 lines in ascending second order: second_start_ms|Decimal::normalize(price_milliseconds)|1000 followed by LF. Each second area is checked exact Decimal sum of trade_price*covered_integer_ms.
opening_method.coverage: All 60 source-time seconds must have exactly 1000ms of real predecessor/real trade price coverage. Receipt, first in-window tick, kline or interpolation cannot fill missing evidence.

historical_recovery.source: Existing immutable Binance original-trade archive plus bounded current-owner raw evidence; no new feed and no aggTrades fallback.
historical_recovery.freeze: start_time_ms=window_start_ms-60000; through_trade_id=first retained actual trade with supplier T>=window_start_ms; require final history.v1 page complete=true and coverage_verified=true, no missing_ranges, one real predecessor and all raw SHA/row bindings valid.
historical_recovery.history_preimage_encoding: UTF-8, no BOM; literal marketcow.binance-opening-history.v1 then LF; decimal integer start_ms|boundary_ms then LF; then rows in ascending trade_id: predecessor, every in-interval trade, first successor at/after boundary inclusive. Each row is trade_id|supplier_T_ms|normalized_decimal_price|normalized_decimal_quantity|lowercase_true_or_false_maker|lowercase_raw_frame_sha256_hex|source_epoch then LF. No whitespace or final extra bytes.
historical_recovery.history_sha256: Lowercase hex SHA256(history_preimage_encoding). Each row is re-derived from raw_base64 after SHA256(raw bytes)==raw_sha256==evidence_ref; no receipt-derived time.
historical_recovery.source_epochs: Distinct source_epoch strings in first-appearance order from the predecessor and trades with T<boundary; successor's epoch is excluded unless it also contributed before boundary. Count 1..64; >64 fails closed with history_opening_epoch_capacity.
historical_recovery.first_successor: Included in history hash to prove the window's upper bound, but its price and epoch never contribute to the opening TWAP or opening_source_epochs.
historical_recovery.resource_bounds: Original history.v1 freeze: 30s build, 64MiB session, 64 pages, 64000 trades plus one predecessor; failure remains unavailable with exact reason and no partial opening.

binding_sha256.encoding: UTF-8, no BOM. Literal domain followed by LF. Then six values each followed by LF in this exact order: market_id, condition_id, window_id, rule_sha256, opening_seconds_sha256, opening_evidence_kind. Then for every opening_source_epochs element in encounter order: literal epoch: plus epoch plus LF. If and only if history kind: literal history: plus opening_history_evidence_sha256 plus LF. Finally window_start_ms|window_end_ms|Decimal::normalize(opening_price_usdt), no final LF. No length prefixes; values are the validated market identity/hex epoch/hex SHA and decimal atoms and must not contain LF or pipe.
binding_sha256.output: opening_evidence_sha256 is lowercase hex SHA256 of these exact bytes. The fixed vector includes base64 of these bytes and expected hash.

live_single_epoch.opening_source_epoch: same nonempty string as the sole opening_source_epochs element

verified_history.opening_source_epoch: sole opening_source_epochs element when count=1; JSON null when count>1

unavailable.opening_reason: required nonempty machine string; history_recovery_pending or exact historical failure when applicable

current_independence: Current availability and live source epoch are independent of immutable opening availability; source outage cannot erase a previously bound opening. available=true only when both opening_available and current_available.
vector_generation: The fixed vector is generated by the production history reduction, production opening_binding_preimage, production window_comparison_at, and serde_json::to_vec serializers in the opening_v3_serializer_vector test. It includes three original synthetic supplier trade frames, the exact history and binding preimages, and exact nested comparison JSON bytes; observed_at uses a fixed injected UTC clock. The SHA of serialized nested JSON is a vector integrity check, not an additional runtime signature or trading gate.
